mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the tight labor market leads to higher wage growth and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary tightening cycle in response to high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth GDP regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized), strong economic expansion supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
